description: Ortholog conservation at catalytic and substrate-pocket positions plus three-panel summary figure
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,"helpers.py")).read())
D=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"akr_panel.json"))); S=D["seq"]; PF=D["pf"]

rows=[]
for k in ["AKR1B1_h","AKR1A1_h","AKR1C3_h","AKR7A2_h","LGalDH_Arath","AKR6A_KCNAB2_h","AKR6_Hk_Dmel","MEC14_Cel"]:
    s,e=PF[k]; L=len(S[k]); rows.append(dict(protein=k,length=L,n_ext=s-1,c_ext=L-e))
ct=pd.DataFrame(rows); ct.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"terminal_extensions.csv"),index=False)

pocket_mec=[103,136,137,166,204,205,209,175,174,307]
tetrad_mec=[133,137,163,204]
orth=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"uniref50_members.json")))
ms,me=PF["MEC14_Cel"]; mec=S["MEC14_Cel"]
res=[]
for acc,rec in orth.items():
    sq=rec.get("seq","")
    if acc=="Q20127" or len(sq)<150: continue
    a1,a2,_=nw_affine(mec[ms-1:me], sq); mp=pos_map(a1,a2)
    p_=pct_id(a1,a2); p_=float(p_[0]) if isinstance(p_,tuple) else float(p_)
    m2o={ms-1+i:j for i,j in mp.items()}
    row={"acc":acc,"organism":rec.get("org",""),"pid":round(p_,1)}
    for p in tetrad_mec+pocket_mec:
        j=m2o.get(p); row[f"{mec[p-1]}{p}"]=(sq[j-1] if j else "-")
    res.append(row)
od=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("pid",ascending=False)
od.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"pocket_ortholog_conservation.csv"),index=False)
cols=[c for c in od.columns if c not in ("acc","organism","pid")]
cons={c: round(100*float(np.mean([r==c[0] for r in od[c]])),1) for c in cols}
print(f"Orthologs scored: {len(od)} (UniRef50 cluster of Q20127), identity {od.pid.min()}-{od.pid.max()}%")
print("Per-position identity to the C. elegans residue (D133 Y137 K163 Q204 catalytic; rest pocket):")
for c in cols: print(f"   {c:>6}: {cons[c]:5.1f}%")
print()
print(od.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17.5,5.4))
lbl=["Y202","V203","Q204","I205","H206","D207"]; d=[10.83,8.86,0.93,9.76,5.76,11.37]
ax[0].bar(lbl,d,color=["#c0392b" if x<3 else "#bdc3c7" for x in d])
ax[0].axhline(3.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax[0].set_ylabel("distance to L-GalDH His124 side-chain tip (A)")
ax[0].set_title("A. Residue occupying the catalytic-His site\nMEC-14 vs L-GalDH, 228 CA pairs, RMSD 1.01 A",fontsize=10)
ax[0].text(2,1.7,"Gln204",ha="center",color="#c0392b",fontweight="bold")

pk=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"substrate_pocket_map.csv"))
y=np.arange(len(pk))
ax[1].barh(y,pk.ca_dev,color=["#2980b9" if v<3 else "#d35400" for v in pk.ca_dev])
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{a} > {b}" for a,b in zip(pk.akr1b1,pk.mec14_by_struct)],fontsize=8)
ax[1].axvline(3.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel("CA deviation after superposition (A)")
ax[1].set_title("B. AKR1B1 substrate pocket onto MEC-14\norange: no structural counterpart",fontsize=10)

x=np.arange(len(ct))
ax[2].bar(x-0.2,ct.n_ext,0.4,label="N-terminal",color="#7f8c8d")
ax[2].bar(x+0.2,ct.c_ext,0.4,label="C-terminal",color="#16a085")
ax[2].set_xticks(x); ax[2].set_xticklabels(ct.protein,rotation=55,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_ylabel("residues outside PF00248"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_title("C. MEC-14 has a 96-residue N-terminal and\nan 80-residue C-terminal extension",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
